Only when you are right at the reader (within ~0.9 m) does it change to 'Press and hold F to unlock'. Hold F for 1 s: the ring fills while a hand presses the reader (LED blinks blue), then the door opens for 8 s with a countdown and locks again once the doorway is clear. From inside reception F opens it as usual. The amber workspace doors stay closed. On phones, hold the action button. Next to the reader's padlock icon there is now a small black box with the same status (Locked / Hold F to unlock / Unlocking… with a progress bar / Door unlocked with the countdown).
